rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for wanting to know, ask questions, or investigate.

example.english: I'm curious why you came back so early.
example.traditional: 我好奇你點解咁早返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou3 kei4 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zou2 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for the negative, nosy sense of being curious about other people’s business.

example.english: Don't be so curious, always asking how much other people earn.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁八卦，成日問人哋人工幾多。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baat3 gwaa3 seng4 jat6 man6 jan4 dei6 jan4 gung1 gei2 do1

rows.note: Use this when “curious” means strange or unusual rather than inquisitive.

example.english: It's really curious that you're still cooking this late.
example.traditional: 你咁夜仲煮飯，真係奇怪喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 je6 zung6 zyu2 faan6 zan1 hai6 kei4 gwaai3 wo3
